phase1_compatibility_read_only.compatibility: Candidate child tables can reference existing episode_uid while preserving nullable/QA binding semantics. No migration was applied.

alert_episode.role: Canonical continuous AIR parent and denominator identity.

alert_state_snapshot.role: One source alert/state snapshot at one poll time, including active-with-zero-components and clear snapshots.

field_kinds.source_geo_scope: source fact normalized without losing raw geography

alert_threat_observation.role: One source threat/cause member observed inside one snapshot.

field_kinds.component_signature: inferred deterministic continuity key where justified
field_kinds.source_ended_at: source fact, optional only; never filled from absence

threat_component.role: Continuity grouping across observations; may be inferred and is not treated as upstream object identity.

component_interval.role: Interval interpretation with uncertainty bounds and explicit end_basis.

effective_severity.role: Overall current severity computed from source observations; never episode identity.

episode_id.why: Required only after safe BOUND resolution; must remain null for AMBIGUOUS/UNBOUND.

source_alert_id.why: Retain when supplied; proven for Alerts.in.ua, absent in accepted UkraineAlarm/Kyiv shapes.

source_threat_id.why: Schema permits it when a source supplies one, but no native threat ID is proven in the accepted three shapes.

observed_at.why: Snapshot time is the canonical primitive for polling observations and uncertainty bounds.

level_raw.why: Not all sources expose per-component Yellow/Red.

cause_raw.why: Structured cause exists in Alerts.in.ua/Kyiv but not every source shape.

reason_raw.why: UkraineAlarm exposes reason text; other source shapes may not.

source_message_raw.why: Retain Alerts.in.ua source_message when present without making it component identity.

source_started_at.why: Source fact only; absent for Kyiv causes.

source_ended_at.why: Source fact only; never filled from disappearance between polls.

is_active.why: Snapshot alert activity is adapter/source-state interpretation; child activity is represented by membership in the snapshot.

raw_object_path.why: Useful provenance pointer when an object locator exists.

severity_normalized.why: Safe exact mapping where level exists; raw level remains authoritative.

threat_type_normalized.why: Exact conservative mapping with unknown fallback; raw cause/reason remains authoritative.

effective_severity.why: Max known component severity or explicit scalar fallback; never episode identity.

derived_component_interval.why: Continuity/end bounds are reconstructed from snapshots; not a source fact.

ukrainealarm.parent_identity: EPISODE_BOUND; no native AIR alert ID proven
ukrainealarm.snapshot: AIR object selected by regionId + type=AIR; object absence represents clear for that region in the proof adapter
ukrainealarm.component_identity: Deterministic inferred signature over source + region + AIR + raw reason + source_started_at; not claimed as upstream identity.
ukrainealarm.end_semantics: No source component end is invented; disappearance gives an uncertainty bound.

alerts_in_ua.parent_identity: source alert.id retained; stability across composition changes remains NOT_PROVEN
alerts_in_ua.snapshot: one Alert object; threats[] treated as currently open threats
alerts_in_ua.component_identity: Deterministic inferred signature over source + location + alert type + alert start + threat_type + threat started_at; no native threat ID assumed.
alerts_in_ua.scalar_alert_level: Retained separately; not substituted for component history.

kyiv_official.parent_identity: EPISODE_BOUND; no native episode ID proven
kyiv_official.component_identity: SNAPSHOT_ONLY in persisted source facts; any cross-snapshot same-cause continuity is explicitly inferred.
kyiv_official.severity: state is not mapped to Yellow/Red; component and effective severity remain unknown unless another explicit level exists.

identity_strategy.snapshot_key: versioned SHA-256 over source + source alert/geography locator + observed_at + source_state_at + raw payload hash
identity_strategy.threat_observation_key: versioned SHA-256 over snapshot_key + canonical threat fingerprint + deterministic duplicate ordinal after sorting
identity_strategy.ukrainealarm_component: DETERMINISTIC_INFERRED; collision risk if two distinct upstream components have same region, raw reason and source start; therefore not called native identity
identity_strategy.alerts_in_ua_component: DETERMINISTIC_INFERRED; same caution, because no native threat ID is documented
identity_strategy.kyiv_component: SNAPSHOT_ONLY persisted; ADJACENT_SNAPSHOT_INFERRED only in derived interval logic
identity_strategy.versioning: all deterministic identities are version-labelled so mapping/key changes can coexist

deduplication.same_snapshot_replayed: same snapshot_key and same threat_observation_keys; idempotent
deduplication.same_component_new_poll: new snapshot observation but stable inferred component signature where source supplies stable start/type fields
deduplication.changed_source_message: new threat observation retained; component signature unchanged when message is not part of component identity
deduplication.array_order: sorting canonical threat fingerprints makes keys independent of source array order
deduplication.red_added: same parent snapshot stream; additional child observation only
deduplication.red_disappears: absence closes only a derived component interval with bounds; no source end fabricated
deduplication.all_threats_disappear_air_active: zero-child active snapshot retained; parent AIR remains active
deduplication.air_clear: clear snapshot closes parent only through existing episode semantics; still-open child intervals get EPISODE_CLOSE_INFERRED bounds
deduplication.process_restart: replaying same stored snapshot remains idempotent

time_uncertainty.rule: If a component is present at T1 and absent at T2, source_ended_at remains null; end_lower_bound=T1, end_upper_bound=T2, end_basis=SNAPSHOT_INFERRED. No exact derived_end_at is emitted unless SOURCE_EXPLICIT.
time_uncertainty.episode_close_rule: If AIR clears while components were still present in the final active snapshot, each open derived child receives last_seen_active_at..episode_end as bounds and end_basis=EPISODE_CLOSE_INFERRED; source_ended_at remains null.

episode_binding.rule: Use project target city + AIR type + safe temporal containment/overlap, with native/source identity where available. Differentiated data may bind only to an existing canonical episode in this proof.
episode_binding.guard: AMBIGUOUS and UNBOUND keep episode_id null and cannot create, split, extend or otherwise mutate denominator episodes.

geography.target_city: stored independently as project target city
geography.rule: A RAION observation remains RAION even when attached to a city target; binding does not make it city-exact.

effective_severity.rule: max(red > yellow) across known active component severities; if no known component severity, optional source scalar alert_level fallback; otherwise unknown
effective_severity.cross_source: never merge source components automatically; derive per chosen source view or explicit later reconciliation layer

threat_type_normalized.persistence: DERIVED per observation while raw value retained

component_interval.reason: source evidence lacks reliable exact end timestamps and, for Kyiv, stable native per-cause IDs

coverage: Case C same severity multiple causes
Case E component disappears between polls
Case F AIR closes with open children
Case H cross-source taxonomies remain independent
Kyiv no fake cause start or severity
all causes disappear while AIR remains active
changed source message retains new observation without fake component restart
source-explicit end cannot be confused with inferred end
test_results.case_c: Two simultaneous Alerts.in.ua synthetic threats with distinct causes and level=red both remain separate; effective severity derives red.

production_regression.method: Full branch comparison against authoritative base shows only newly added proof files. No pre-existing production/canonical file changed; therefore the complete existing episode corpus, boundaries, identities, attack-event binding inputs and denominator are byte-identical.
production_regression.note: Regression does not rely on treating any one historical baseline snapshot as the latest metric state; it relies on zero modifications to every pre-existing file plus focused non-mutation tests.

unknowns: UkraineAlarm: complete Yellow-only -> Yellow+Red -> Yellow-only -> clear raw upstream chain remains uncaptured; the transition test uses evidence-supported synthetic fixtures.
UkraineAlarm: exact upstream component-removal event semantics and same-level duplicate component behavior remain unproven.
Alerts.in.ua: alert.id stability across threat-composition changes is not proven.
Alerts.in.ua: real concurrent Yellow+Red threats[] and differentiated history retention remain unproven.
Kyiv: direct raw history chain and exact per-cause end semantics remain unproven; persisted cause identity therefore stays snapshot-only.
Cross-source reconciliation is intentionally deferred; observations from different sources are not auto-merged.
